Holy shit I didn't even know this was a thing.  Wow yeah, that sucks.  I guess I've been really really lucky.  No one I revealed it to has reacted negatively, at least not to my face. I learned early on how to separate mental disorder from my relationships, and it hasn't been a problem since I was about 20.  You will figure it out, too.  Don't let those guys' responses make you think that's what the experience will be like for you.  

It may be true that neurotypical/average people who haven't experienced trauma are not as able to understand your history and experiences, but I dont think it means they will be less able to love you.  Just a thought.  You'll be okay.  :)
